lines.zh: 我在死谷的灰土上慢慢走。
lines.en: I walk slowly over the grey soil of the dead valley.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳一节压着一节。
lines.en: My shell plates press one over another.
I thread between dead branches.

lines.zh: 我的触须一直探在前面。
lines.en: My feelers are always reaching ahead.
I step over pale grey moss.

lines.zh: 我在死谷里巡着自己的路。
lines.en: I patrol my own path through the dead valley.

lines.zh: 我的背壳很厚，走起来发沉。
lines.en: My back plates are thick and heavy to carry.

lines.zh: 风把灰土吹到我的关节里。
lines.en: The wind blows ash into my joints.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块倒下的枯树。
lines.en: I go around a fallen dead tree.

lines.zh: 枯谷里我走走停停，甲壳刮着沙。
lines.en: Through the dead valley I pause and go, shell scraping sand.

lines.zh: 我沿着干裂的地面往前。
lines.en: I work forward along the cracked ground.
My shadow stays flat on the ground.

lines.zh: 我用前腿挑起一块石子。
lines.en: I flick a pebble away with a front leg.
This dead valley is very quiet.

lines.zh: 我一步步走向谷里的低处。
lines.en: I move step by step toward the lower ground.

lines.zh: 我停在灰土上，甲壳不动。
lines.en: I stop on the ash and my shell goes still.
Fine ash has settled in my joints.
I listen to the wind through dead trees.

lines.zh: 我的触须慢慢转了一圈。
lines.en: My feelers turn a full circle slowly.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和这片土一样。
lines.en: My color matches this soil.

lines.zh: 我在等灰土里有什么动。
lines.en: I'm waiting for something in the ash to move.

lines.zh: 我的背甲反着一点冷光。
lines.en: My back plate catches a little cold light.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，很难被看到。
lines.en: I hold still; I'm hard to spot.
I open my mandibles slowly.
I hear a stone roll somewhere far off.
You look soft.
My shell is thicker than your skin.
You've trodden on my ash.
I've lived in the dead valley a long while.
Your boots are covered in white ash.

lines.zh: 我判断你不需要害怕我。
lines.en: I judge you have no need to fear me.
I lift my head and pause.
Are you going to touch me?
You're standing in my path.
I'm in no hurry; I'll wait for you to move.

lines.zh: 我的六只脚都抓在地上。
lines.en: All six of my feet are planted.

lines.zh: 我的甲上多了一道白痕。
lines.en: A white line has appeared on my shell.
I pull my legs in and steady.
That left me ringing.
I give half a step and ash lifts.
Fluid seeps from my joints.
I lower my head to guard my feelers.
I can take this much.
I shift slowly back into place.
All my joints are creaking.
I'll try again.
Did you bring food?
I don't know that smell.

lines.zh: 我的上颚只适合啃硬东西。
lines.en: My mandibles are for hard things.
What's in your hand?
I'll come a little closer to look.
This can't be edible.
Just take half a step back.
Let me smell it first.
This smells much better than ash.
Don't hold it up like that.
On the dead valley's narrow path, I go first.
I slide half a foot from the impact.
I pull back and reset my legs.

lines.zh: 这条窄道只够一个过去。
lines.en: This narrow path fits one of us.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳擦过你的裤腿。
lines.en: My shell scrapes your trouser leg.
You've pushed me off my line.
I shift slowly back.

lines.zh: 这一下让灰土扬了起来。
lines.en: That sent ash into the air.
There are other shells in the dead valley.
We touch feelers.
We walked a stretch side by side.
It went under the ash.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着一块石头。
lines.en: We hold one stone together.
There's a crack in its shell.
It left first; I didn't follow.

lines.zh: 灰土把我们的痕迹盖住了。
lines.en: The ash covered both our trails.
I can push this stone.
I pick it up with my mandibles.
It's heavy, but I don't mind.
I drag it under my shell.

lines.zh: 掉在灰里的，我先翻一翻。
lines.en: I turn over what's fallen in the ash.
I carry it back with me.
Too heavy; I brace with another leg.
I bury it at the burrow mouth.
This is one of my collection.
Something's moving in the ash.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，六条腿扣地。
lines.en: I crouch and set all six legs.
I'm waiting for you to come nearer.
My shell has turned forward.

lines.zh: 我抬起尾刺，你身上的热气暴露了。
lines.en: I lift my tail sting; your body heat betrays you.
You've backed to the far side of a dead tree.
My feelers went still.
I've seen you; don't plan on leaving.
There's no other way out of here.
No need to run; I'm steadier than you.
I shift in your direction.

lines.zh: 灰土把我的脚都埋住了。
lines.en: The ash has buried my feet.

lines.zh: 我沿着灰土的边跟过去。
lines.en: I follow along the edge of the ash.
You take a step; I shift half a foot.
My color keeps me hidden.
I know this dead valley better than you.

lines.zh: 我在等你的靴子陷进去。
lines.en: I'm waiting for your boot to sink.
I'm counting how often you step.
The dead valley's paths twist about.
I've taken the short way.
I won't leave you an opening.
I shove with a foreleg.
My mandibles close on your bracer.

lines.zh: 死谷里，我是最大的那只。
lines.en: In the dead valley, I'm the biggest.
I drive my whole shell into you.
You're pushed back one step.

lines.zh: 我的腿在你脚边钩了一下。
lines.en: My leg hooks at your feet.
You pull free and I draw back.
My mandibles can't bite iron.
I twist free.
I come up out of the ash.
One more shell in the dead valley.
The soil here is white.
First I test the wind.
I crawl out from under a fallen tree.
My six legs find their footing.
This valley is quiet as death.
I raise my head and look around.

lines.zh: 我在这里第一眼看到的是灰。
lines.en: The first thing I saw here was ash.
Fire sears my shell and I pull in.

lines.zh: 我从石头上翻下去，甲磕响了。
lines.en: I tumble off a stone and my shell clangs.

lines.zh: 水灌进节缝，我动得很慢。
lines.en: Water fills my joints and I slow down.
The blast lifts me right off the ground.
An arrow lodges in a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 光落在甲上，我不太舒服。
lines.en: Light falls on my shell; it doesn't sit well.
There's little to eat in this ash.
Lightning creeps across my shell.

lines.zh: 这里没有地给我的六条腿。
lines.en: There's no ground for my six legs here.
